_comment: OpenLane 2 configuration for hardening the RISC-V core with the open SkyWater sky130 PDK. NOT RUN: OpenLane/OpenROAD and the PDK are not installable in the environment this repo was developed in. Treat as a starting point, expect to tune CLOCK_PERIOD and FP_CORE_UTIL. The core's memories are outside riscv_core, so it is a pure-logic block that hardens without a memory macro.
